subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should the shared plain-text compatibility wrapper execute valid standalone JSON assistant text across Ollama, LM Studio, xAI, and similar providers, or should the linked failure be solved through provider-native tool-call normalization?
rationale: Both approaches can address the reported failure, but the PR changes a shared plugin-facing provider behavior, and automation cannot choose that permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept shared JSON fallback
options.body: Land the shared behavior after exact-path live proof confirms one promotion and no visible-text leakage.

options.title: Prefer provider-native normalization
options.body: Rework the fix around native provider tool-call events and leave standalone JSON assistant text non-executable.

options.title: Require provider opt-in
options.body: Add an explicit provider-owned capability before enabling JSON-text promotion rather than changing the shared default.

recommendation.title: Accept shared JSON fallback
recommendation.body: Land the shared behavior after exact-path live proof confirms one promotion and no visible-text leakage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to provider runtime, plugin SDK contracts, and shared plain-text repair policy.
